id.description: Persistent entity ID within the Dataset; use it for detail lookup.

state.description: Campaign approval state: Proposed, Approved, or Archived. Approved does not necessarily mean actively serving.

status.description: Current serving status: Active, Inactive, ScheduleCompleted, or BudgetReached. Distinct from approval state.

advertiserName.description: Associated advertiser name; empty when the source cannot resolve the advertiser.

budget.description: Campaign budget, discriminated by type (currently cpm), with an optional spending cap. CPM and spending cap use the same monetary unit.

startsAt.description: Inclusive campaign start timestamp with UTC offset; null means no start boundary.

endsAt.description: Inclusive campaign end timestamp with UTC offset; null means no end boundary.

modified.description: Time the entity was last modified, with UTC offset.
